evidence.title: Goodman marks construction of data centre in Sydney's north as global work in progress grows to $18B
evidence.excerpt: Goodman says it officially marked commencement of construction at SYD01 in Artarmon and that the future facility will be fully fitted and operated by Goodman with 61 MW total IT capacity across five 12.2 MW phases.

metadata.construction_scope: The dated first-party article records official construction commencement on March 2, 2026. The current property page later directly calls SYD01 under construction and supplies the normalized current generic status. Neither source isolates site preparation, clearing, civil works, excavation, foundations, structural frame, shell, MEP, energization, commissioning, completion, occupancy, or operation.
metadata.role_scope: The article places SYD01 within Goodman's own development program, describes Goodman's integrated design and delivery platform, says Goodman is set to deliver the facility, and explicitly says the future facility will be fully fitted and operated by Goodman. This supports Goodman as developer and intended operator, not as proof of present operations.
metadata.capacity_scope: The article explicitly types 61 MW as total IT capacity, says it will be delivered through five 12.2 MW phases, and separately identifies 90 MW of secured utility or primary power. The current property and pipeline pages corroborate the same typed dimensions.
metadata.phase_nonaggregation_guardrail: The five 12.2 MW phases reconcile to the 61 MW total IT scope. They are nested components, not five additive capacity rows or five separate project or campus identities. Phase 1's 12.2 MW and Q2 2028 forecast remain metadata only.
metadata.forecast_guardrail: Q2 2028 is a phase-delivery forecast, not actual completion, ready-for-service, commissioning, energization, occupancy, operation, current load, or an invented exact target date.
